bullets.title: NVDA Earnings Drive Broad Market Volatility Pricing
bullets.body: SpotGamma's Brent Kochuba notes NVDA earnings are "driving S&P options volatility" with traders positioning for lower rates. SPX is pricing in an additional 0.25% move for NVDA earnings Thursday, while Friday's Jackson Hole event is pricing 0.5% additional SPX movement. The 0DTE straddle at $25/32bps on 7,670 implies PCE data is expected to be a non-event.

bullets.title: NVDA Expected to Report $92.2B Revenue (+97% YoY) at 4:20 PM ET
bullets.body: Consensus expects Nvidia to report approximately $92.2 billion in revenue for the latest quarter, representing 97.2% year-over-year growth. Wall Street attention is reportedly moving beyond near-term earnings to a potential $200 billion off-balance-sheet AI credit exposure risk by 2028.

bullets.title: GS Prime: Semis vs. Software Positioning Divergence (Leopold Trade)
bullets.body: Goldman Sachs Prime is tracking a notable divergence in client positioning between semiconductors/semi equipment (green line) and software/IT services (red line) as a percentage of the full prime brokerage book. Data suggests active rotation between these two tech sub-sectors among institutional clients.

bullets.title: JPM: CTAs Accelerating Buying Near 4.60% 10Y Yield Threshold
bullets.body: JPMorgan's morning Market Intel notes chatter of commodity trading advisors (CTAs) accelerating buying activity as the 10-year Treasury yield approaches 4.60%, identifying that level as a key trigger point for systematic buying flows.

bullets.title: Oil Drops 3%+ on Iran-Oman Hormuz Reopening Talks; Hedgeye Turns Bearish
bullets.body: Brent and WTI crude futures fell over 3% after Iran and Oman signaled progress on Strait of Hormuz negotiations, with satellite imagery also showing Gulf producers ramping output. Hedgeye flags oil breaking its TRADE and TREND technical levels with capital flowing out of oil positions.

bullets.title: Reuters Poll Raises S&P 500 Year-End 2026 Target to 7,900
bullets.body: A Reuters poll of Wall Street strategists lifts the S&P 500 2026 year-end target to 7,900 from 7,620 in the May survey, citing strong corporate earnings, booming AI investment, and easing geopolitical tensions. The DJIA forecast was also raised to 54,500 from 52,500.

bullets.title: Record Negative High-Beta vs. Low-Volatility Correlation—Market Divergence Signal
bullets.body: The 45-day correlation between high-beta and low-volatility stocks has hit the most negative level on record, signaling an unusually sharp bifurcation in market risk appetite that could indicate style-factor stress or a pending mean reversion.

bullets.title: AI Capex: $32M per MW Based on $8M Rack Pricing Analysis
bullets.body: A fintwit analyst breaks down AI infrastructure costs: a single rack runs $8M and consumes 230-250kW, implying $32M per MW or $32 billion per gigawatt of compute capacity—a figure relevant to assessing hyperscaler capex cycles.

bullets.title: China AI Infrastructure Spend Surges 9x YTD; DeepSeek Eyes $74B Valuation
bullets.body: China AI infrastructure spending jumped from RMB 1.2 billion in 2025 to RMB 11 billion through July 2026. Separately, DeepSeek is reportedly seeking $7.4 billion in new funding at a $74 billion valuation, underscoring intensifying Chinese AI investment momentum.

bullets.title: AMD Confirms Zen 6 'Ryzen' CPU Roadmap: Olympic Ridge & Medusa Families
bullets.body: AMD officially confirms its Zen 6 desktop CPU family ("Olympic Ridge") on the AM5 socket and Zen 6 mobile families ("Medusa1" and "Medusa2") on the FP10 socket, providing visibility on the next-gen consumer silicon roadmap.

bullets.title: META Gains Pre-Market on State AG Settlement Talks
bullets.body: Meta Platforms was cited as gaining in pre-market trading (up 1.5%) with the catalyst attributed to developments in state attorney general settlement negotiations.

bullets.title: MSFT Criticized for Capex and Cloud Disclosure Opacity (WSJ)
bullets.body: WSJ's 'Heard on the Street' column highlights Microsoft's lack of transparency on capital expenditure levels and cloud business segmentation, raising concerns about investors' ability to assess financial guidance and capex allocation.

bullets.title: OpenAI Sales Exec Returning to Salesforce—Enterprise AI Talent Signal
bullets.body: OpenAI sales executive Peter Doolan is reportedly returning to Salesforce, a potential signal of enterprise AI commercialization momentum shifting back toward established software platforms.

bullets.title: AMZN Sees Canadian Package Volume Growing Faster Than US
bullets.body: Amazon projects its Canadian package volume will grow faster than US volumes over the next several years, signaling international logistics expansion as a near-term priority.

bullets.title: PCE Inflation Due: Headline 3.6%, Core 3.3% Expected
bullets.body: The Fed's preferred inflation gauge (PCE) was expected at 8:30 AM ET; consensus called for headline PCE at 3.6% and core PCE at 3.3%. Options market pricing treated the release as a near-non-event relative to NVDA earnings.

bullets.title: Consumer Confidence Signals Demand Weakness; Student Loan Delinquencies at Post-2020 High
bullets.body: The Conference Board's August spread between expectations and present conditions widened to persistently negative territory. Separately, 10.6% of student loan balances are now 90+ days delinquent, the highest rate since 2020, adding to consumer credit stress signals.

bullets.title: Housing: Existing Inventory Hits Decade High, New Home Supply Remains Constrained
bullets.body: Existing single-family home inventories reached their highest level in a decade while months' supply for new homes rose in July but stayed below pre-pandemic norms. FHFA House Price Index printed flat at 0.0% m/m in June vs. +0.2% consensus, suggesting price momentum has stalled.

bullets.title: High-Yield Credit ($HYG) Prints All-Time High; Hedgeye Stays Long Healthcare (+7.8% Aug)
bullets.body: Hedgeye flags $HYG posting a new all-time high, calling out economic bears who've been wrong on credit in 2026. The firm also remains long healthcare (XLV), which has gained 7.8% in August alone and 13% over the past month.

bullets.title: Debasement Trade Reportedly Replacing AI Mania as Market Narrative
bullets.body: Bloomberg's Eric Balchunas notes the 'debasement trade' is starting to replace AI mania as a dominant market narrative, with BlackRock cited as a participant in this macro rotation.

bullets.title: BofA: SpaceX Wireless Plans Could Benefit T-Mobile and Tower Companies
bullets.body: Bank of America says SpaceX's wireless ambitions could boost T-Mobile through spectrum and network opportunities and lift tower company valuations, though building a competitive nationwide network would require massive capital and additional spectrum acquisition.
